about: Which folders a folder grant may trust, and the owner's words when it may not. `{home}` is the home folder; the cases run with ~/src/ledger-jobs (a folder holding README.md), ~/.hermes/skills and ~/.openclaw present. `error` is the whole reply after `Not trusted: `, or null when the folder is trusted.

cases.error: "/" is too broad: trust one project folder, not /.
"~" is your home folder or a folder above it: trust one project folder inside it.
"$HOME" is your home folder or a folder above it: trust one project folder inside it.
"{home}" is your home folder or a folder above it: trust one project folder inside it.
"~/src/*" has a wildcard: name one folder, such as ~/src/my-repo.
"src/ledger-jobs" is not a full path: start it with / or ~/.
"~/missing" is not a folder on this machine.
"~/src/ledger-jobs/README.md" is not a folder on this machine.
"~/.hermes/skills" holds the agent's own files: it can never be a trusted folder.
"~/.openclaw" holds the agent's own files: it can never be a trusted folder.
"~/src/../.hermes/skills" holds the agent's own files: it can never be a trusted folder.
